names: Mission Bay Open Space Parcel P26
summary: Mariposa Park, a park on the north side of Mariposa Street between Owens and 4th Streets, which a photo caption on OCII's open-space page labels 'P26 Mariposa Park'. Its outline is the union of Assessor lots 8723003, 8723004 and 8723006, three of the four lots OCII's Long-Range Property Management Plan names for parcel P26 (the plan also lists part of lot 8723007, which the outline leaves out). An undated Rec and Park page says the park includes a playground, picnic area, trellis area and lawn and that, as of July 1, 2023, the department will assume its management and maintenance. No source read gives an opening date.

open_questions: No source read gives Mariposa Park an opening or completion date. Potrero View (March 19, 2016) wrote "When it opens this spring" (an expected date, written before the opening); an undated Rec and Park Mariposa Park page describes the park and says the department will assume its management and maintenance as of July 1, 2023, and the City's June 30, 2023 announcement says Rec and Park would oversee it from July 1, 2023 (an announced date; the announcement is dated the day before).

OCII's plan lists parcel P26 on lots 8723-003, 004, 006 and 007(p) and gives 87,556 sq ft; the three whole lots in this outline total about 88,443 sq ft, and the plan does not say which part of lot 8723007 it means. Whether any of the park lies on lot 8723007 is not established, so that part is left out.
